batches.title: Batches
batches.emptyOwner: Create your first batch to start taking attendance and billing fees.
batches.emptyMember: The owner hasn’t created any batches yet.
batches.emptyArchived: Batches you archive move here. Their attendance and fee history stay.

batchForm.nameInvalid: The name must be 2 to 80 characters
batchForm.subjectInvalid: The subject can be at most 60 characters
batchForm.timeInvalid: The batch must end after it starts
batchForm.feeInvalid: Enter the fee in whole rupees
batchForm.feeNote: Used for students who join from now on. Students already in the batch keep their fee.

batch.subject: Subject
batch.archiveBody: It disappears from attendance and new bills. Its attendance and fee history stay.
batch.archivedNote: This batch is archived. Its history is kept, but it can no longer be changed.

students.emptyOwner: Add your students to take attendance and send fee reminders.
students.emptyMember: The owner hasn’t added any students yet.

studentForm.title: Add student
studentForm.nameInvalid: The name must be 2 to 80 characters
studentForm.guardianNameInvalid: The guardian name can be at most 80 characters
studentForm.phoneHelp: Fee reminders and absence alerts go to this number on WhatsApp.
studentForm.notesInvalid: Notes can be at most 1000 characters
studentForm.noBatches: No batches yet. You can add the student to batches later.
studentForm.consent: The parent agreed to receive updates on WhatsApp
studentForm.consentHelp: Without this, no automatic WhatsApp messages are sent to this number.
studentForm.rollInvalid: The roll number can be at most 20 characters
studentForm.rollTaken: Another student already has this roll number
studentForm.studentPhoneHelp: If the student has a phone: calls, WhatsApp and (with consent) the same updates as the parent.
studentForm.studentPhoneSame: This is the parent's number. Leave it empty if the student has no phone of their own.
studentForm.studentConsent: The parent agreed the student's number gets updates on WhatsApp

student.removeBody: Today is the last day. No new fees for this batch from the next billing.
student.creditHelp: Paid but not yet applied to any fee. Shared by brothers and sisters.
student.readOnly: Read-only on your plan. Upgrade, or mark other students as left, to change this student.
student.leftBody: From today: no new fees and no reminders. Their history stays and they no longer count toward your plan.

studentEdit.title: Edit student
studentEdit.newNumberConsent: The parent agreed to receive updates on WhatsApp on this new number
studentEdit.newNumberHelp: WhatsApp consent belongs to a number. A new number starts without it.

bulkAdd.title: Add many students
bulkAdd.help: One student per line: the name, then the parent's mobile. The parent's name can follow after another comma.
bulkAdd.label: Students
bulkAdd.example:
Aarav Sharma, 98765 43210
Riya Gupta, 98765 00000, Neha Gupta
bulkAdd.tooMany: At most {{max}} students at a time. Split the list.
bulkAdd.consent: The parents of all these students agreed to receive updates on WhatsApp
bulkAdd.failedTitle: Not added: {{count}}. Fix these lines and try again.

today.heading: {{weekday}}, {{date}}
today.noClassesHelp: A batch shows here on the days it meets.
today.waiting: Attendance for {{count}} classes is saved on this phone and will be sent when you're online.

register.title: Attendance
register.help: Tap a student who is absent. Everyone else is present.
register.noStudents: No students in this batch on this day.
register.alertsQueued: Absence messages will go to {{count}} parents on WhatsApp.
register.alertsTooLate: Saved, but no absence messages were sent: it's after 10:00 the day after the class, and a late message would confuse parents.
register.skippedReadOnly: {{count}} students were not saved: your plan's student limit was lowered. Upgrade, or mark students who left as left.
register.savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It will be sent by itself when you're online.
register.failedDate: This day can't be changed any more: attendance can be saved up to 7 days back.
register.failedNotEnrolled: Some students are no longer in this batch on this day. Open the class again and save.
register.failedArchived: This batch is archived, so its attendance can't be changed.

studentAttendance.title: Attendance
studentAttendance.howCounted: Late counts as attended. Leave doesn't count either way.

payment.title: Record payment
payment.extraCredit: {{amount}} more than is due: it will be kept as the family's credit.
payment.closed: This invoice is already paid, waived or cancelled.

invoiceActions.help: "Send reminder" sends our WhatsApp fee reminder to the parent (all of this family's dues) and to the student's own number, if any. "WhatsApp" opens a chat with the message typed for you.
invoiceActions.reminded: Reminder queued: it goes out in a moment.
invoiceActions.remindLater: Reminder queued for {{time}} (no messages at night).
invoiceActions.alreadyToday: This parent already got a fee reminder today.
invoiceActions.notInPlan: Automatic WhatsApp reminders aren't in your plan. Use "WhatsApp parent" to send it yourself.
invoiceActions.nothingDue: Nothing is due on this invoice any more.
invoiceActions.forceBody: This parent already got a fee reminder today. Send one more? (At most one extra a day.)
invoiceActions.parentMessage: Hello, this is a reminder from {{institute}}: {{student}}'s fee ({{description}}) of {{amount}} is due on {{date}}. Thank you!

ownerActions.reasonInvalid: Write a reason (it is kept in the records).
ownerActions.waiveBody: {{amount}} still due will be forgiven. Payments already made stay.
ownerActions.cancelBody: Use this for an invoice made by mistake. It will no longer be due.
ownerActions.conflict: This invoice changed meanwhile (for example, a payment arrived). Go back and open it again.
ownerActions.voidBody: Use this for {{amount}} entered by mistake. The invoices it paid will be due again.

manualInvoice.title: Add invoice
manualInvoice.descriptionInvalid: Write what this invoice is for (up to 200 characters).
manualInvoice.discountInvalid: The discount must be less than the amount.

notices.emptyHelp: Tell parents about a holiday, a change of class time, or anything else, on WhatsApp.
notices.oneBatch: A timing change is for one batch.
notices.reasonInvalid: Write a short reason (up to 80 characters).
notices.datePast: The date can't be in the past.
notices.resumeAfter: Classes must resume after the holiday starts.
notices.goesTo_one: It goes to {{count}} number on WhatsApp.
notices.goesTo_other: It goes to {{count}} numbers on WhatsApp (parents, and students with their own number).
notices.overQuota: Only {{count}} can go out now; the rest will be skipped (message limit).
notices.consentNote: Only numbers whose owner agreed to WhatsApp updates get it. Nothing is sent between 9 PM and 8 AM.
notices.noRecipients: No parents to send to: these batches have no active students today.
notices.notInPlan: Notices need a plan with WhatsApp messages.
notices.dailyLimit: You can send {{limit}} notices a day. Try again tomorrow.

messages.noneInPlan: No WhatsApp messages in your plan
messages.today: Today: {{used}} of {{limit}} (new institutes and the trial have a daily limit)
messages.trialTotal: During the free trial: at most {{limit}} messages in total
messages.failedHelp: WhatsApp couldn't deliver it. Check the number, or contact the parent yourself.

skip.opted_out: Not sent: the parent turned off WhatsApp updates.
skip.no_consent: Not sent: the parent hasn't agreed to WhatsApp updates.
skip.over_quota: Not sent: the message limit was reached.
skip.plan_disallows: Not sent: your plan doesn't include these messages.
skip.nothing_due: Not sent: nothing was due any more.
skip.stale: Not sent: it was out of date by sending time.
skip.expired: Not sent: it waited too long (e.g. quiet hours, no internet).
skip.institute_paused: Not sent: messaging is paused for this institute.
skip.platform_limit: Not sent: WhatsApp's sending limit was reached. It wasn't counted.

consent.title: WhatsApp updates
consent.on: The parent agreed: fee reminders, absence alerts and notices go to this number.
consent.off: Turned off: no automatic WhatsApp messages to this number.
consent.unknown: Not asked yet: no automatic WhatsApp messages until the parent agrees.
consent.stoppedEverywhere: The parent replied STOP on WhatsApp: no automatic messages until they send START.
consent.confirmBody: Turn this on only if the parent said yes to getting fee reminders, absence alerts and notices on WhatsApp.

tests.title: Tests
tests.notInPlan: Tests and result cards need the Pro plan.

testForm.name: Test name
testForm.maxInvalid: Enter the maximum, like 25 or 12.5 (up to 1000).
testForm.maxBelowHighest: The maximum can't be below the highest mark given ({{highest}}).

marks.noStudents: No students were in this batch on the test date.

results.title: Test results
results.saveFirst: Save the marks first, then send.
results.confirmBody_one: {{count}} student has marks: their parent gets a result card on WhatsApp.
results.confirmBody_other: {{count}} students have marks: each parent gets a result card on WhatsApp.
results.confirmNote: Students with their own number get it too, if they agreed. Absent students get none. A card already sent isn't sent again.
results.notYet: This test's date hasn't come yet.
results.deleteBody: The test and all its marks are deleted. Result cards not sent yet won't go out.

instituteSettings.billingDayInvalid: Billing day: a day from 1 to 28 (every month has it)
instituteSettings.dueExample: Fees are billed on day {{billing}} of the month and due on day {{due}}.
instituteSettings.dueExampleDays: Fees are billed on day {{billing}} and due {{days}} days later.
instituteSettings.upiHelp: Parents pay this UPI ID directly. The money comes straight to you; Coaching Desk never takes a cut.
instituteSettings.upiInvalid: Enter a UPI ID like yourname@okaxis
instituteSettings.upiInReminders: Show my UPI ID in fee reminders
instituteSettings.upiInRemindersHelp: Fee reminders will tell parents where to pay. No payment links are ever sent.
instituteSettings.upiNeeded: Add your UPI ID above to turn this on.
instituteSettings.upiPreview: Reminders will end with: Pay by UPI to {{upiId}}
instituteSettings.absenceAlertsHelp: A message to the parent when their child is marked absent.
instituteSettings.remindersHelp: Around each due date. Up to {{max}} days; at most one reminder a day per number.
instituteSettings.remindersOff: No automatic fee reminders (you can still send one from an invoice).
instituteSettings.languageHelp: The language of the WhatsApp messages parents get (not this app's).

team.help: People who can open this institute in the app. They log in with their own mobile number.
team.name: Name
team.phoneHelp: They get access when they log in with this number.
team.teacherHelp: Takes attendance, enters marks, sends notices. Doesn't see fees.
team.staffHelp: Front desk: students, batches, attendance, fees and payments. Can't waive or void.
team.limit: Your plan allows {{limit}} team members (besides you). Upgrade, or remove someone first.
team.notInPlan: Your plan doesn't include team members. Upgrade to add teachers or staff.
team.already: This number is already in your team.
team.removeBody: They lose access to this institute right away. Their past attendance and marks stay.

plan.limits: {{students}} students · {{team}} team members · {{messages}} messages a month
plan.featureMessages: Automatic WhatsApp reminders, alerts and notices
plan.upgradeSoon: Paying for a plan in the app is coming soon. Until then, contact us to change your plan.

data.exportBody: A ZIP file with one spreadsheet per area: students, batches, attendance, fees, payments, tests, messages and more.
data.exportNote: It holds parents' phone numbers: keep it safe. It is ready in a minute or two and kept for 7 days.
data.dailyLimit: At most 5 exports a day. Try again tomorrow.
data.deleteBody: Deletes every student, batch, fee, payment and message of this institute after 30 days. Download your data first if you need it.
data.deleteConfirm: We'll send a code by SMS to your phone to confirm it's you. Teachers and staff lose access at once; nothing is sent to parents; you have 30 days to cancel.
data.codeSent: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your phone.
data.pendingBody: Everything will be deleted on {{date}}. Until then teachers and staff can't open it and no messages are sent. You can still download your data.

erase.title: Delete {{name}}'s personal data?
erase.body: For a parent's request: the name, parent, phone numbers and notes are removed for good. Invoices and payments keep their amounts (without the name).
